remarks: This exceptional property offers an ideal blend of convenience, comfort, and natural beauty. Perfectly situated in desirable Westcott Cove neighborhood, located in coveted Bishop Meadows association tucked away offering beautifully manicured grounds with clubhouse and in ground pool, providing effortless access to a wealth of amenities, while its serene surroundings create an atmosphere of relaxation. This impeccably maintained tri-level townhouse features over 2300 sqft with 2 spacious bedrooms and 2.5 baths and closets galore. The open-concept dining and living area with sliding doors leading to a private deck, is perfect for both entertaining and quiet enjoyment. The second level boasts two generously sized bedrooms with ample closet space, complemented by rare 2 well-appointed full bathrooms. The fully finished walk out lower level offers a versatile family room with cozy fireplace, an abundance of storage space and a private laundry room, providing additional comfort and functionality. Whether lounging by the pool or strolling along the beach, this home offers an unparalleled lifestyle just steps from your door. Walk to beach, park, tennis courts & Chelsea Piers. Easy Commute minutes to train, downtown restaurants & shopping, 1 Reserved parking space(in front of unit) & plenty of visitor parking.
